name: get_weather_forecast
description: Get weather forecast for a location with temperature, humidity, wind, and precipitation

location.description: Location as city name (e.g., 'San Francisco, CA') or coordinates (e.g., '37.7749,-122.4194')

forecast_type.description: Type of forecast: 'current' for current conditions, 'hourly' for 24-hour forecast, 'daily' or '7-day' for multi-day forecast

days_ahead.description: For daily forecast: number of days ahead (1-7)
